data.body: PS3 (Gerrit 2305): fixed the PS2 ubuntu CI failure. Root cause was NOT the fix logic — the held-out oracle test_sync_only_scalar_update_dispatch_heldout.py built its subprocess environment with a raw dict(os.environ), which trips the repr-safety governance gate (tests/unit/test_subprocess_env_repr_security.py). That gate is Linux-only, so macOS py3.13 passed while all 3 ubuntu tiers failed. Fixed by routing the spawned env through the sanctioned tests/_subprocess_env.py::subprocess_env() boundary (repr-safe, values preserved for the child). Oracle + governance gate + lint + typecheck all green locally; pushed PS3.
